description: This file defines the 'Total' class within the OpenCart system, specifically extending the Model class. It contains a method 'getTotal' that adds a total entry to the provided totals array, suggesting it is used to compute or include total-related data in the shopping cart or order process.

classes.name: Total
classes.description: Represents a total extension in the OpenCart catalog model, responsible for handling the 'Total' part of the order total calculation.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates or adds the total information to the provided totals array. It loads language files, prepares a total entry with code, title, value, and sort order, and appends it to the totals array.
